reference: Chevrolet Corvette Z06 (C8, 2023 on), LT6 5.5 L naturally aspirated DOHC flat-plane-crank V8 with 4-2-1 stainless headers per bank, valved exhaust and centre-exit quad tips, US specification. Engineering reference only.

interior.source: Car and Driver, Z06 coupe, Nov 2022: 94 dBA at full throttle [M] (S14). Idle and 70-mph levels were not obtained: 58 and 72 dBA are research estimates [E].

notes.engine.firingOrder: [P] 1-4-3-8-7-6-5-2 (S12 firing-order references; S06 Corvette spec guide). Not seen in a GM document.
notes.engine.banks: [A] GM numbering: odd cylinders 1-3-5-7 on the left bank (GM 'bank 1', driver's side of a left-hand-drive car), even 2-4-6-8 on the right, front to rear. In the C8 the engine's front (accessory drive) faces the cabin, so cylinder 1 is the left-bank cylinder nearest the cabin. Applying GM's front-engine convention to the mid-mounted LT6 is the assumption (research). With it the banks strictly alternate, 1L 4R 3L 8R 7L 6R 5L 2R: the left bank fires 1-3-7-5 and the right 4-8-6-2, each the inline-four pattern 1-2-4-3 by position, one firing every 180 degrees.
notes.engine.crank: [P] Flat-plane (180-degree) forged crank, four throws, no balance shafts (S07). Even 90-degree firing; each bank's pulses are 180 degrees apart, like an inline-four, so there is no cross-plane burble.
notes.engine.displacementCc: [P] 5,463 cc from the 104.25 x 80.0 mm bore and stroke (S07); 5.5 L nominal [F].
notes.engine.idleRpm: [E] Not published; 900 rpm warm idle, matching the car config. Reviewers call the idle 'ragged'.
notes.engine.limiterRpm: [F] Redline 8,600 rpm (S02, S33); [P] the fuel cut is at 8,600 and full-throttle upshifts complete at about 8,500 (S19). Matches the car config.
notes.exhaust.collectors: [F] Stainless 4-2-1 headers per bank (S02, S07). [E] Pairing not published: the standard 4-2-1 pairing for a bank firing 1-2-4-3 by position joins cylinders 360 degrees apart, so the left bank's secondaries take 1+7 and 3+5 and the right bank's 2+8 and 4+6 (research). Each secondary gets one pulse per revolution and each bank collector one every 180 degrees. The four collectors here are the secondaries; primaryLengthM 0.40 [E] is a primary length for a 4-2-1 tuned to about 7,500 rpm (not published).
notes.exhaust.merge: [E] Separate banks: no crossover. Not published, but aftermarket cat-back systems advertise adding an X-pipe, which hints the factory system has none (research, S24).
notes.exhaust.outlets: [P] Centre exit: four round tips in one row in a single diffuser bezel (S24, S29b), two per bank here. [E] Pipe lengths (collector, catalyst and pipe to the silencer 1.6 m; tail 0.25 m) and the 89 mm diameter are estimates for a short mid-engine system; the two banks are near mirror images (2 cm apart), and both tips sit the same distance from a listener on the centreline (offsetM 0).
notes.exhaust.muffler: [F] Valved active exhaust with four modes, Weather, Tour, Sport and Track (all valves open), and valves that move in 2-degree steps (S24). [E] Modelled as Sport: valves shut at idle and light low-rpm load, open above 3,500 rpm or half throttle. Filter corners are the shared defaults, with the open path a little brighter (4.2 kHz) for a free-flowing high-rpm system.
notes.exhaust.gasTempK: [E] Hot full-load exhaust of a high-revving naturally aspirated engine (1,100 K in the primaries, 750 K downstream).
notes.exhaust.rasp: [E] 0.45 (default 0.35): reviewers describe a shriek and a wail at the top end (S15, S22, S27), and strong full-load pulses sharpen most in a free-flowing 4-2-1 system.
notes.exhaust.pulseShape: [E] evoDeg, pulseRiseDeg and pulseDecayDeg are the shared defaults, calibrated against recordings (docs/AUDIO.md); the LT6's cam timing isn't published (cam phasing authority about 55 degrees intake and 25 exhaust, S07).
notes.intake.level: [E] 0.40 (default 0.25). Twin 87 mm throttle bodies feed a split plenum right behind the cabin (S08), and reviewers single out the induction sound (S27).
notes.intake.airboxHz: [E] 120 Hz: Helmholtz resonance of one 5.5 L plenum (S08) through its 87 mm throttle-body neck, about 118 Hz. That is where each bank's intake pulses arrive at about 3,500 rpm, where GM's torque chart steps up (S01).
notes.intake.runnerLengthM: [E] 0.22 m, short runners for 8,600 rpm (not published).
notes.mechanical: [E] Valvetrain 0.012 (default 0.008): DOHC with finger followers on solid lifters with shims (S07). Injectors 0.010 (default 0.006): direct injection up to 350 bar (S06), which ticks.
notes.idle: [E] Roughness 0.10 and a slight lope 0.08: reviewers call the idle 'ragged' (research), with long-duration cams for 8,600 rpm.
notes.overrun: [E] No source describes pops or crackles; the research expects a clean overrun with a light crackle at most in Sport and Track, so burble is low (0.10).
notes.limiter.free: [E] Free revving: 12 bounces a second, 250 rpm deep. A light flat-plane engine (inertia 0.14 kg*m^2 in the config) falls and recovers quickly; the bounce character isn't published.
notes.limiter.load: [E] In gear: 8 bounces a second, 150 rpm deep (research estimate of about 150 rpm), 40% of each bounce cut.
notes.loops.rpmPoints: [E] Idle to the limiter, closer together at high rpm (1.39x apart at the bottom, 1.18x at the top) where this engine spends its time.
notes.loudness.interior: [M] 94 dBA at full throttle, Car and Driver's Z06 coupe (S14; the convertible measured 96). [E] Idle 58 dBA and 70-mph cruise 72 dBA are research estimates; C/D's idle and cruise figures were not obtained.
notes.loudness.loadRangeDb: [E] Shared default: closed against full throttle at the same rpm.
